faqData.q: What is your main area of expertise?
faqData.a: I am a Frontend Engineer based in Palembang. I build web interfaces with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS, focusing on visual detail, animation, and accessibility. I am currently a D-IV Informatics Management student (IPK 3.55/4.00, semester 4).

faqData.q: Are you available for an internship or collaboration?
faqData.a: Yes. I am open to internships, freelance work, and technical collaborations. Reach me via the contact form or email; I usually respond within 24 hours.

faqData.q: What tech stack do you use?
faqData.a: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, native PHP, MySQL, and Git (proficient). Plus TypeScript, Oracle, Java, Python, and C++ (beginner). Everything else I am still learning.

Four real projects: LearnEase (an LMS redesign during a 5-month internship, team of 5), MI POLSRI Study Program Profile Website (native PHP and MySQL, built solo), Nusantara Kopi (a coffee-event site, team of 4, live on Vercel), and Portofolio v3 (this site, Next.js 16, TypeScript, Tailwind, Framer Motion, Three.js).

faqData.q: How do we start a partnership or project?
faqData.a: Use the contact form above or reach out directly by email. I usually respond within 24 hours.
